verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt, which includes agent-directed instructions. They also confirm markdown versions of the Billing docs (billing.md, and the many .md doc URLs), which together give agents machine-readable docs to consume. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully using these docs for Billing workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
